messages:
julia_sales: Heads up — NimbusCorp wants to flip signer order on OF-4582 and route countersign to procurement. Any assignment carveout ok? cc @alex_legal @mike_procurement

alex_legal: They propose a broad assignment clause for M&A. MSA currently limits assignment. We can offer narrow M&A exception that preserves data/KMS obligations. Any PO milestones tied to signature order?

mike_procurement: They also want net45 and vendor escrow in Appendix B. That impacts invoice routing and AR. If they sign exec-first, our countersign after PO review — can we accept pre-signed PO?

emma_se: For POC they need 30-day eval + dedicated pool (2x vGPU) for load tests. That will change SLA targets for p95.

sanjay_se: Ops note: reserving 2x vGPU for 4 weeks is ~+$12k. Need finance ok before committing.

olivia_finance: We can do net45 only with 50% deposit for dedicated capacity. Otherwise require upfront.

alex_legal: Draft language: "Notwithstanding Section 9, Customer may assign in connection with a merger/acquisition to an Affiliate or successor, provided Redwood receives prior written notice and assignee agrees in writing to be bound and to comply with Customer's data residency and KMS obligations." Will redline to keep liability/SLA caps intact.

julia_sales: Customer pushes to remove "prior written notice" and make assignment free. They'll escalate if we don't concede.

devops_bot: Provisioning queued: workspace `nimbus-eval`. ETA 48h after legal greenlight + payment hold cleared.

customer_liaison: They want POC next week — can legal fast-track?

alex_legal: I can produce redline + comments in 2 hrs. Uploading when ready.

julia_sales: Plan: Alex redlines -> Olivia confirms deposit -> I coordinate signature flow & get NDA -> Devops provisions sandbox. Will update with final OF and signature sequence.
